description: Throwaway self-signed EC (P-256) test certificate, generated once with: openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out key.pem && openssl req -new -x509 -key key.pem -days 3650 -out cert.pem -subj "/CN=appduct-test-fixture". Only the public certificate is needed; the private key was discarded after generating expectedPin. Inlined here (rather than a .pem file) per this repo's rule that no key material -- including throwaway test fixtures -- is ever committed as a .pem file.
